_comment: Out-of-sample state-program repeal reforms: neutralize a state credit variable and compare the simulated change in national state_income_tax (state credit variables are defined_for their state, so the national change IS the state change) to the state's official program cost. For a refundable credit the repeal effect equals total payments; for the nonrefundable portion it equals the amount used against liability, matching how revenue departments report claims. Restricted to programs with strong tax-year official actuals; the state_program_levels.json backtests cover the wider set. Washington's WFTC is levels-only: WA levies no income tax, so the state_income_tax measure would not capture its repeal.
